examples.anchor: The firm hired forty engineers in May.
examples.paraphrase: In May, forty engineers got jobs at the firm.
examples.edit: The firm fired forty engineers in May.

examples.anchor: This lens fits older camera bodies.
examples.paraphrase: Older camera bodies will accept this lens.
examples.edit: This lens does not fit older camera bodies.

examples.anchor: Either of the keys will open the safe.
examples.paraphrase: Each of the two keys works on the safe.
examples.edit: Neither of the keys will open the safe.

examples.anchor: The contract runs for five years.
examples.paraphrase: The agreement lasts half a decade.
examples.edit: The contract runs for fifteen years.

examples.anchor: The rule does not require students to wear uniforms.
examples.paraphrase: Under the rule, students face no duty to wear uniforms.
examples.edit: The rule requires students not to wear uniforms.

examples.anchor: Apple sued Samsung over the patent.
examples.paraphrase: Apple took Samsung to court over the patent.
examples.edit: Samsung sued Apple over the patent.
